ios.desc:
Walk more. Scroll less. Feel better.

Struggling with screen time? This app helps you break the cycle by turning walking into the key that unlocks your favorite apps and websites. Set the apps or web domains you want to limit, choose how much walking earns you screen time, and let healthier habits build themselves—step by step.

How It Works
	•	Select apps & websites to limit Social media, streaming, games—choose what you want to take control of.
	•	Set your movement goals Decide how many steps unlock how much screen time. You set the rules.
	•	Earn screen time by walking: The more you walk, the more time you earn to use the apps you’ve locked.
	•	Get healthier without trying: Every scroll becomes a reason to walk. Healthier habits come naturally.

Why You’ll Love It
	•	Helps reduce mindless scrolling
	•	Encourages daily movement in a simple, rewarding way
	•	Builds sustainable habits backed by behavior science
	•	Works automatically—no complicated setup
	•	Customizable for your lifestyle and goals

Take control of your digital life while feeling healthier and more energized every day.

Walk your way to better habits—starting today.
